title: failed to exec: ENOENT: No such file or directory
body:
Thanks for this terrific library! I really like how much complexity it wraps!

Im trying to use this library on a variety of architectures. The code seems to work great for `x86_64` but panics on any other architecture I try to run it (`aarch64`, `arm`, `powerpc64`, `s390x`).


Is this a limitation of the library? A bug? Or am I doing something wrong?

title: MemFdExecutable takes a Vec<u8> instead of &[u8]
body:
What is the specific reasoning behind `MemFdExecutable::new` taking a `Vec<u8>`? Looking at the code, it seems like it is used as a `&[u8]` when spawning the process anyway.

In my specific use case, this would force me to allocate a vector just for that purpose which is quite wasteful since statically linked executable tend to be on the bigger side.
